necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of unexplained syncope and near-syncope, raising concern for intermittent arrhythmia. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, prolonged mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary to correlate symptoms with potential cardiac rhythm disturbances. This diagnostic procedure is critical for evaluating the underlying cause of the syncope in the context of diagnosis code R55.
